findings.title: "Seat ring" and "purge shoulder" definitions are narrower than the broader claims they must support
findings.attack: [0058] defines 'seat ring' as converting a load applied by 'the purge shoulder' specifically, and [0063] defines 'purge shoulder' as contacting 'the seat ring' specifically. Claim 15's collar-based load-applying surface and [0182]'s purge shoulder acting on the wiper ring both fall outside these lexicographic definitions even though they are within the claims and elsewhere in the disclosure, creating a construction conflict a court must resolve against the patentee's own express definitions.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Update [0058] and [0063] to use the genus terms ('the load-applying surface', 'the radially deflectable element') consistently with [0067], [0071], [0072] and [0081].

findings.title: figures.md's "candidate, not confirmed" status for FIGS. 11/12 contradicts description.md's and claims.md's unconditional treatment of the same subject matter
findings.attack: figures.md states the slotted sleeve, split seat ring, tapered seat ring, core body bore relief and wall slots are 'not stated in the inventor's disclosure... pending inventor confirmation', and registry.md flag 4 leaves this as an open question. description.md incorporates the identical subject matter without any such qualifier, and claims.md claims it outright. If figures.md is accurate, claims 40-44 and 67 rest on unconfirmed candidate subject matter, contrary to the rule that generated content is a candidate until a human gate confirms it.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Reconcile the two documents: either remove the 'candidate/pending confirmation' language from figures.md and registry.md if the subject matter is now confirmed, or hedge the description paragraphs and flag claims 40-44/67 as pending confirmation if it is not.

findings.title: Reference numeral 146 never appears in the description text
findings.attack: Numeral 146 (purge gap of the two-piece seat) exists only in registry.md and the FIG. 9A/9B drawing instructions; description.md never names or numbers the gap the wiper ring opens, and claim 1 itself uses the numeral with no antecedent.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add numeral 146 to [0182] where the wiper ring's deflection is described.

findings.title: "Radially deflectable element" and "load-converting geometry" have no preferred-term row in the locked terminology table
findings.attack: These two genus terms are central to the description and to claim 1/3 but are absent from terminology/LOCKED.md as their own preferred-term rows; the closest entries are differently-worded Broader-column synonyms under 'seat ring' and 'convoluted wall'. LOCKED.md's own Note 1 concedes the table was not cross-checked against all Prompt 03 features. This is a defect in the lock, not a drafting drift.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add preferred-term rows for both terms to terminology/LOCKED.md, or correct the description/claims to the existing Broader-column wording.

findings.title: FIG. 13A / numeral 220 is registered but has no description text
findings.attack: registry.md and figures.md register FIG. 13A and numeral 220 (Schrader-pattern core body); description.md's brief description of drawings jumps from FIGS. 12A/12B directly to FIG. 13B, and no body paragraph mentions FIG. 13A or numeral 220 at all.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add a brief-description entry and body paragraph for FIG. 13A, or remove it and numeral 220 from figures.md/registry.md.

findings.title: "FIGS. 13B is" grammatical number mismatch
findings.attack: Plural "FIGS." governs a single figure reference and singular verb.

corrections.from_text: produces a radial deflection of the radially deflectable element, and the radial deflection opens a purge gap
corrections.to: produces a radial expansion of the radially deflectable element, and the radial expansion opens a purge gap
corrections.reason: "Radial deflection" is a listed synonym, not the locked preferred term "radial expansion" used everywhere else in the specification and claims.

corrections.from_text: a wall that converts an axial load applied by the purge shoulder in the over-travel into a radial expansion that opens the purge gap
corrections.to: a wall that converts an axial load applied by the load-applying surface in the over-travel into a radial expansion that opens the purge gap
corrections.reason: Aligns the lexicographic definition of "seat ring" with the genus term used in claim 1/15, avoiding a construction conflict with the collar embodiment of claim 15.

corrections.from_text: that is spaced from the seat ring throughout the normal stroke, that contacts the seat ring only in the over-travel, and that applies the axial load which produces the radial expansion
corrections.to: that is spaced from the radially deflectable element throughout the normal stroke, that contacts the radially deflectable element only in the over-travel, and that applies the axial load which produces the radial expansion
corrections.reason: Aligns the lexicographic definition of "purge shoulder" with the genus term, consistent with [0182]'s use against the wiper ring.

corrections.from_text: FIGS. 13B is an axial section of an embodiment in which the valve core is integral with the valve stem.
corrections.to: FIG. 13B is an axial section of an embodiment in which the valve core is integral with the valve stem.
corrections.reason: Grammatical number mismatch: single figure reference with plural "FIGS."

corrections.from_text: In over-travel the purge shoulder 44 bears on the wiper ring 144 and deflects it outward, as shown in FIG. 9B.
corrections.to: In over-travel the purge shoulder 44 bears on the wiper ring 144 and deflects it outward, so that a purge gap 146, closed at rest, opens between the wiper ring 144 and the core body bore 22, as shown in FIG. 9B.
corrections.reason: Numeral 146, used in claim 1, otherwise has no antecedent anywhere in the description text.

assumptions.text: A1. The Prior-Art Analyst's/Specification Drafter's inventor-confirmation status is not visible to this review; F-38-2 is reported as an unresolved contradiction, not a conclusion.
A2. No numeral_crosscheck artefact was supplied; this audit performed a manual cross-check in its place and may not have caught every discrepancy across all 350 paragraphs.
A3. "As used herein" definitions are treated as controlling lexicography over ordinary claim-term meaning, as common general knowledge of claim construction practice.

open_questions.text: Q1. Whether FIGS. 11/12's subject matter has inventor confirmation, given the direct contradiction between figures.md/registry.md and the unqualified description/claims treatment.
Q2. Whether the locked terminology table was meant to carry "radially deflectable element" and "load-converting geometry" as their own preferred terms.
Q3. Whether a numeral_crosscheck file exists elsewhere in the run outside this task's supplied inputs.
